Review: This page is written so it can also serve as the Impressum required in Germany (§ 5 DDG) and Austria (§ 5 ECG, § 25 MedienG) when Otto launches there, including a German version. Check before that launch: a second fast contact channel besides e-mail (the phone number), the register court as well as the number, and whether a person responsible for editorial content (§ 18 MStV) must be named for our blog or social profiles. The EU online dispute resolution platform closed on 20 July 2025, so no link to it is needed; a statement on consumer dispute resolution (§ 36 VSBG) is not needed while Otto sells to businesses only.
